incident_title: Availability failure on Live E2E Checkout API Health Check
investigation_summary: Database outage or connection pool exhaustion causing DatabaseError on checkout API

report.incident_summary: The health check failures are caused by a DatabaseError (500) on the checkout endpoint, indicating a backend database outage or connection issue at the time of the incident.

root_cause_hypotheses.title: Database outage or connection pool exhaustion causing DatabaseError on checkout API
root_cause_hypotheses.explanation: The checkout health check hit a 500 response with exception type DatabaseError and a long latency (3200 ms). This suggests the service could not obtain a database connection or the DB became unavailable, leading to request timeouts and failures across all health checks.
missing_evidence: Network latency between service and DB
verification_steps: Check database server status and logs for outages or errors at 2026-11-20 11:44 UTC
Inspect connection pool usage and exhaustion metrics in the service monitoring
Review recent network incidents or firewall changes affecting DB connectivity
Confirm no recent code changes impacted DB queries or connection handling

recommended_next_steps: Verify DB health and logs for the incident window
Inspect service connection pool and retry metrics
Check network paths between the API service and the database
Confirm no silent deployments or config changes were applied
limitations: No direct database telemetry or logs were provided
Absence of connection pool metrics limits ability to confirm exhaustion
No deployment or config change data to rule out recent code impact
